steps.body: Three numbers that add up make a family: the two parts and the whole. Knowing one fact in the family unlocks the others.
steps.narration: Three numbers that add up make a family: the two parts and the whole. Knowing one fact in the family unlocks the others.

widget.prompt: Use the family 9, 4, 13: start at 13 and count back 9. Where do you land?
widget.missFeedback: Start at 13 and count back 9: you land on 4.
widget.successFeedback: Landed on 4 — removing one part of the family leaves the other part.

predict.reveal: Removing one part from the whole leaves exactly the other part of the family.
